precedence.style: v19 replaces v18 as the active common character drawing standard; use this approved scene for line/color/shading/paper texture
precedence.identityAndPoses: v18 32 originals remain immutable historical/pose/anatomy references; representative 24
precedence.mouths: v18 09/01/11/17 remain structural mouth references and existing conservative measurement anchors

characteristics.line: Warm umber/brown pencil contours, finer varied pressure and paper grain; avoid heavy uniform near-black sticker borders
characteristics.color: Layered warm cream/ochre instead of flat bright ivory; restrained mint with warm/green pencil variation; peach cheeks
characteristics.shading: Soft accumulated pencil shadows at hat folds, door edges, sleeves, mittens and apron; retain readable form without glossy 3D gradients
characteristics.texture: Visible directional hatching and paper tooth inside colored surfaces; harmonize with scene pencil density without transparent holes
characteristics.expression: Simple dark eyes/mouth remain readable; no human pupils or new anatomy inferred
